description: This file appears to be an HTML document that sets up a web page containing a CodeMirror editor configured for HAML syntax highlighting. It includes scripts to load CodeMirror core, HAML mode, and other language modes, as well as inline example HAML code within a textarea for editing and testing.

methods.name: fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a textarea element, configuring line numbers and HAML mode.
